answer: Propose a meadow of per-key, independently salted data shards: at one unpredictable pulse, auditors request nonce-masked bytes from every active key simultaneously. Validators verify signed byte receipts and cap each key at one slot. A farm can share its model and rent a fat uplink, but cannot multicast distinct shards; each clone must reserve another 2 Gbps of live egress for the same minute, including any leased capacity. A missing receipt sends that key to nadir: its pending reward is forfeited. These are proposed auditor and validator rules, not MinePoA policy.
